title: Volvo says it will use Nvidia's Hyperion platform to launch a Level 2++ hands-free, point-to-point automated driving system by 2030 (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
summary: Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge: Volvo says it will use Nvidia's Hyperion platform to launch a Level 2++ hands-free, point-to-point automated driving system by 2030 — The system will be similar to Tesla's Full Self-Driving in that it will enable hands-free, point-to-point partially automated driving on local roads.
